structure: transparent background, logo above, company and product names on two rows

findings.finding: The logo is clear, but both text rows use too little of the available width at desktop icon sizes.
At 32 and 64 pixels the company name is recognizable mainly by overall shape; increasing the source text size will preserve more glyph detail after downsampling.
Gold text has insufficient edge separation on light desktop backgrounds because the delivered icon is intentionally transparent.

recommended_change: Increase company text from 76 to 100, product text from 70 to 112, move baselines to approximately 350 and 475, and add a thin #17150c outline while preserving transparency.
